findings.text: §5 requires "among accepted names, the count with accepted documentation is at least the 2,368 read before the drain", but the paragraph above it records that §52 "restored 391 names to their own accepted documentation", and the record §5 cites for that restoration (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-restore-reset-docs.html`, section "Accepted-name docs_stage counts") reads `accepted 2497, pending 721` after the restore, against a 2,368 floor — so the floor is already cleared by work this section attributes to §52, and the clause can hold however little §5 does
